messages.subject: Re: how to pass quoted text to a function?
parts:
curve <- reactive({
Rates(trade.date = input$tradedt)
})

Then you can call curve() to get the value, but only within a renderXXX or a reactive() or an observeEvent(), or similar reactive constructs. If that's making no sense to you, you might want to go through the Shiny tutorial on shiny.rstudio.com if you haven't already.

HTH!
On Sat, Sep 24, 2016 at 7:18 AM <glennm...@me.com> wrote:
I have function which takes a character as input as follows
Rates(trade.date = "08-15-2016")

I have tried and tried to pass the text input to the function in Shiny as shown above and I cannot seem to get it work.  I know this has got to simple but I cannot figure it out.  I am pretty sure I need to use quoted.  Any suggesting are appreciated.

ui.R
textInput(InputId = "tradedt", label = "Trade Date")

server.R
curvedate <- renderText(quote({input$tradedt}), quoted = TRUE)
curve <- Rates(trade.date = curvedate)
